title: TctRenewalMessages
description: AITP v0.3 TCT renewal (RFC-AITP-0013, Draft, opt-in). Two shapes: the renewal request, a bare JSON object POSTed to the issuer's rfc-aitp-0005.renew_uri (RFC-AITP-0013 §3), and the payload of the issuer's `tct` response envelope (RFC-AITP-0013 §6). TCTs and vouchers are opaque compact JWS strings (RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.5).

anyOf.title: RenewalResponsePayload (payload of the message_type=tct response envelope)

CompactJws.description: RFC 7515 compact JWS: exactly three non-empty unpadded-base64url segments. Embedded verbatim as an opaque string.

PopNonce.description: 16 random bytes as 22 unpadded base64url characters (RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.2).

RenewalPopSignature.description: base64url(sign(holder_key, sha256(renewal_pop_input))), renewal_pop_input per RFC-AITP-0013 §3.1. MAY carry an algorithm tag prefix; a p256 holder MUST (RFC-AITP-0001 §5.4.3).

current_tct.description: The TCT being renewed, verbatim, typ 'aitp-tct+jwt'. Decoded claims validate against aitp-tct.schema.json.

pop_nonce.description: Fresh holder-chosen nonce, new for every request.

pop_signature.description: Renewal PoP by the key encoded in the current TCT's sub.

tct.description: The renewed TCT, typ 'aitp-tct+jwt'. Decoded claims validate against aitp-tct.schema.json.

grant_voucher.description: OPTIONAL companion grant voucher for the renewed TCT, typ 'aitp-grant+jwt', src_jti = the renewed TCT's jti (RFC-AITP-0005 §8.2).
